title: Exeggutor's Three Heads Can Stop It Moving

direction.premise: Exeggutor's three independent heads can make its whole body unable to move.
direction.audiencePromise: See how three separate wills can lock Exeggutor in place, then discover the teamwork that restores its power.
direction.openLoop: What happens when Exeggutor's three heads disagree?
direction.payoff: Conflicting directions stop Exeggutor completely, but cooperation lets its heads unleash powerful psychic energy.
direction.engagementQuestion: Teamwork, or one mind per body?

voice.instructions: Warm, quick, and curious. Stress words like "three," "split," and "unable." Use short pauses before each reveal, then land the final choice playfully.

scenes.headline: THREE MINDS. NO MOVEMENT.
scenes.narration: Three minds can make Exeggutor unable to move.
scenes.caption: THREE HEADS. ONE LOCKED BODY.

scenes.headline: THREE SEPARATE WILLS
scenes.narration: Each head has its own thoughts, so one body carries three separate wills.
scenes.caption: ONE BODY. THREE WILLS.

scenes.headline: A TELEPATHIC PLAN
scenes.narration: They use telepathy to discuss plans before choosing one shared direction.
scenes.caption: DISCUSS. AGREE. MOVE.

scenes.headline: WHEN THE ARROWS SPLIT
scenes.narration: But when those directions split, Exeggutor becomes unable to move.
scenes.caption: LEFT. RIGHT. NOWHERE.

scenes.headline: AGREEMENT UNLOCKS POWER
scenes.narration: When they work together, the same three heads can release powerful psychic energy.
scenes.caption: TOGETHER, THEY HIT HARDER.

scenes.headline: TEAMWORK OR ONE MIND?
scenes.narration: Teamwork, or one mind per body?
scenes.caption: WHICH WOULD YOU CHOOSE?
